boundaries.exact_render: saved physics trace rows replayed with set_qpos; renderer output is an offline reference, not a new physical rollout or event-camera ground truth
boundaries.candidate_geometry: same frozen projected warp and z-buffer; exact identity only at mathematical endpoints; intermediate motion remains unrounded
boundaries.photometry: candidate log-radiance interpolation only where both projected endpoints agree in label and depth; cached exact direct render fills explicit uncertain-pixel requests
boundaries.learned_inputs: causal five-bin event tensors only; GT labels are joined after inference for scoring
